name: Tatooine
climate: Arid and hyper-dry with severe heat from twin suns, freezing nights, and frequent sandstorms
terrain: Endless dune seas, rocky badlands, moisture vaporator canyons, and scattered settlements

name: Naboo
climate: Temperate and gentle with abundant rainfall, warm humid summers, and mild winters
terrain: Rolling verdant hills, lush forest canopies, sprawling swamp estuaries, and deep watery core passages

name: Coruscant
climate: Controlled temperate environment maintained by planetary weather grids and orbital mirrors
terrain: Ecumenopolis covered in multi-tiered skyscrapers, vast steel canyons, and industrial lower levels
